Against the exact Phase 1 candidate, author one read-authorization test and the smallest boundary rule that prevents a history result from being released after its assignment is revoked.
Design and implement an immutable Java scope value used to select case-history records, including equality, hash behavior and defensive copying of event-kind filters.
Implement an immutable history comparator that respects authoritative sequence and provides a total deterministic order for a bounded merged display fixture.
Create a Java result boundary for history loading that distinguishes unavailable data, malformed request and denied/unknown resource without leaking internal exceptions.
Implement one typed Java projection helper for immutable events that cannot accidentally erase source provenance or accept a mutable domain entity as a public DTO.
Write the Java parser and normalized filter value for one read-only history request, including limits and mutually consistent cursor options.
Add learner-authored regression cases that expose a scope-key implementation omitting assignment generation or conflating empty and absent filters; repair only that key seam.
Implement one bounded Java read adapter whose resource lifetime remains correct when mapping the third record fails.
Implement a read-only source-reference resolver for a history event that requires an exact source type, object and revision before producing a navigable reference.
Implement a pure Java pagination model that captures the current authoritative sequence fence and advances only within that fence.
Use a failing lookup to isolate caller mutation of a Java map key, then repair the smallest value boundary with a regression.
Design a single-pass normalizer for at most 100 read-model rows that removes exact duplicate event identities while rejecting contradictory duplicates.
Write a projection reducer that admits only authoritative domain/audit records and handles unknown/reconciled outcomes without deriving business truth from browser analytics.
From a plain decision table with no implementation outline, recreate one executable history-access predicate that handles owner, assigned Support and unknown source revision.
Choose and implement one concurrency protocol for the Support authorization/read-release seam, using a deterministic two-thread schedule and the actual assignment interface.
Implement safe publication of a versioned public filter registry used by concurrent history readers, without caching private result data.
Implement admission and rejection handling for one existing local projection executor with two workers and a queue of three.
Implement cooperative deadline/cancellation handling around a bounded history read task and preserve interruption semantics.
Author an integration test that contrasts self-invocation with proxy-mediated invocation for one existing atomic journey-transition seam, then move only the required public boundary.
Extend the transaction boundary with tests for one checked validation exception and one unchecked failure, choosing an explicit rollback rule for the actual installed stack.
Compare REQUIRED and REQUIRES_NEW for one mandatory audit write and choose the propagation that preserves domain/audit atomicity.
Implement one Spring request validator for date range, page limit and continuation compatibility, mapping its domain errors without leaking rejected raw values.
